summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Vortex Lotto Global Karma 2026. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (health, /games, /quantum/draw for EJ/L649/GS/FR, /projects total=107, /draws CRUD, /analysis). Frontend: All four tabs (Generator, Analyse, Karma, Vision) render correctly on mobile viewport (390x844). Quantum draw button produces correct ball counts per game (EJ=5+2, L649=6+1, GS=7+0 digits, FR=7+0). Karma shows '107 Organisationen', chips filter list (Augsburg filter reduces 76->36 visible items). Analyse: adding numbers via input persists draw, Hot-Zahlen bars render, delete removes draw. Vision shows manifesto + DATENSCHUTZ sections. Tab navigation works. source='crypto' as expected (no ANU key).

issues: IBMPlexSans-Regular/Medium/SemiBold fonts fail to decode via Metro asset URL ('invalid sfntVersion: 168430090') so web falls back to system fonts. Cosmetic only — does not break functionality. Reference: console warnings on every screen load.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated in react-native-web; should migrate to 'boxShadow'. Likely in /app/frontend/constants/theme or LotteryBall/card styles.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — emitted by react-native-web. Search components passing pointerEvents as prop.
'textShadow*' style props are deprecated; should migrate to 'textShadow' shorthand.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate why IBMPlexSans .ttf files served by Metro return invalid sfntVersion on web preview (likely asset content-type / wrapped HTML response). Fonts fall back gracefully so non-blocking.
OPTIONAL: Replace deprecated react-native-web style props: shadow* -> boxShadow, textShadow* -> textShadow, and migrate pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents.
